title: Differential Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the differential cross section sigma(theta).

title: Total Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the total cross section sigma_t.

title: Use of Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the Born approximation and its application to the problem.

title: Integration with Delta Function
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly handle the integration involving the delta function in the calculation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the final answers are consistent and correct.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or misapplication of the delta function.
